title: Tractable bank capital structure: optimal control under Basel III constraints
summary: Banks must optimize risky investments, dividend payouts, and capital structure under tight Basel III solvency and liquidity constraints, while costly equity issuance serves as a distress-recovery tool. We formulate this as a stochastic control problem that reduces the high-dimensional balance-sheet dynamics to a tractable one-dimensional process in the asset-to-deposit ratio, with state-dependent investment limits.
